#{A diversification-oriented Guided Local Search strategy that dynamically penalizes top-utility edges using orthogonal multi-neighborhood ruin criteria, scaling penalties by local vertex congestion and tour variance without randomness.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    max_utility = np.max(utilities)
    mean_utility = np.mean(utilities)
    
    avg_edge = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    std_edge = np.std(tour_lengths)
    
    # Orthogonal ruin criteria: penalize near-maximum utility edges alongside high-relative-cost long edges
    threshold_util = max(0.85 * max_utility, mean_utility)
    threshold_len = avg_edge + 0.5 * std_edge
    
    selected_mask = (utilities >= threshold_util) | (tour_lengths >= threshold_len)
    
    # Ensure at least the maximal utility edge is selected if conditions are strict
    if not np.any(selected_mask):
        selected_mask = utilities >= (0.99 * max_utility)
        
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    
    # Dynamic non-monotonic penalty scaling based on edge utility and recurrence
    base_penalty = 0.25 * avg_edge
    adaptive_factors = 1.0 + (utilities[selected_mask] / (max_utility + 1e-12))
    penalties = base_penalty * adaptive_factors
    
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalties
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalties
    
    return updated_edge_distance
